mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and construction activity, driving positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (GDPC1 and HOUST both rising) fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime (defined by INDPRO growth > 0.5% in 3 months), a rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for INDPRO growth > 0.5% condition is negative or below 0.02 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling potential economic contraction and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for HOUST level is negative or below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive returns in > 40% of instances over a 3-year window.
